_metadata.texto_original: The user's pack cannot lose their Alpha action. Creatures with non-Fetish equipment cannot refuse challenges from the user. The user's Combat Actions get Fast Striking in the first round of any combat initiated by a challenge. When you play Phone Travel, you may search your deck for a Cellular Phone:  shuffle your sept deck and put the Cellular Phone on top.
